# 🇺🇸 Dataset for iOS/macOS Keyboards

This repository contains layout data for any languages. For example, the **Tuvan Cyrillic keyboard**,
designed for integration with Apple Keyboard, Unicode CLDR, and related input systems.

## 📘 Description
The keyboard layout dataset is based on the modern design used in iOS and macOS.

The layouts conform to a unified keyboard scheme and are compatible with layout generation tools for specific platforms.

You can use the approach I used in the example of "tyv – Тыва дыл" (Tuvan language), slightly modifying the layout rows to include all the characters used in the modern writing system of the selected language.

Its goal is to provide native users with a convenient, accurate, and inclusive typing experience.

At a minimum, you need to describe the files ``lang-3-rows.yaml`` and ``lang-longpress.yaml``, where lang is the code of your language.

### A familiar example
Most of you are familiar with the system keyboard for Russian. It's described [here (click here)](https://github.com/Agisight/ios-system-keyboard/tree/main/layout/rus).

GEORGEWWWU/NotchPeninsula.description: Brand new native Windows notch/dynamic island component supporting media control and notification pop-ups, with minimal memory usage and maximum performance
GEORGEWWWU/NotchPeninsula.body:
Want the latest beta version? Join

## Project Overview

NotchPeninsula is a "notch screen" style desktop widget for Windows 10/11, implemented using a combination of Win32 + SkiaSharp + NAudio, with the core goal of integrating system media status, notification messages, and audio visualization into an ultra-narrow floating area at the top of the screen.

It generates a lightweight transparent window at the desktop top, centralizing system media status, notification messages, and audio visualization in an ultra-narrow floating area:

- System media playback status and dynamic island lyrics (including translations and word-by-word lyrics)
- Real-time audio spectrum, time/date display, and CPU/memory usage
- Windows Toast notifications with optional notification sound
- Clipboard link recognition and custom components supporting third-party plugins
- Sleep mode: collapse the island into a small capsule with optional sleep content (time/blank/collapsed media controls)
- Auto-hide, window always on top, mouse pass-through, and auto-update detection

This design is suitable for single-screen, narrow-bezel layouts, and scenarios where you want to preserve desktop space while having interactive feedback.

## Features

| Module | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Media Control** | Automatically takes over system media sessions (browsers/NetEase Music/QQ Music/KuGou/Spotify/Apple Music/Echo Music/LX Music, etc.), supporting play/pause, previous/next track, and timeline scrubbing. **When the system provides both song name and artist**, it's music mode: fetch lyrics and cover online; otherwise, treat as video mode: only show title and app icon without online access |
| **Dynamic Island Lyrics** | Continuously optimize lyrics processing and display, trying APIs in sequence (details below), supporting **translations** and **word-by-word lyrics** (auto-fallback to software-simulated karaoke effect if word-by-word lyrics unavailable); island body auto-adjusts length based on lyrics |
| **Real-time Audio Visualization** | WASAPI Loopback captures system output, analyzes into 5 frequency bands and renders smoothly; retains volume dynamics when no media is playing; automatically follows system default output device |
| **Windows Notifications** | Listen to Toast notifications, support three presentation modes (thumbnail/compact/full) and can be disabled entirely; optional notification sound (14 built-in audio sources or local audio) |
| **Time/Date and Hardware Monitoring** | Built-in time/date and hardware monitoring, unified display and ordering control in **Display Settings** |
| **Clipboard Links** | Event-driven monitoring, automatically pop up panel after copying links, click to open with default browser; zero CPU and zero extra memory at steady state |
| **Just Solo Lyrics** | Integrated with Just Solo LyricServer, fetching time-axis lyrics and server-pushed spectrum; single audio control entry — when connected, adjusts player volume; otherwise, adjusts system master volume |

Leo2148/cj2api.body:
# CJ2API

A Cloudflare Worker that converts [ChatJimmy](https://github.com/Leo2148/cj2api/raw/refs/heads/main/src/api-cj-v1.4.zip) into an OpenAI-compatible API.

One-click deployment to Cloudflare Workers gives you a standard `/v1/chat/completions` interface that's compatible with all clients and frameworks supporting OpenAI API. No API Key required.

## Features

- **OpenAI Compatible** — Standard Chat Completions API format, supporting streaming (SSE) and non-streaming responses
- **Zero-cost Deployment** — Runs on Cloudflare Workers free tier
- **Built-in Test Page** — Visit the root path to test online, includes cURL / Python / Node.js examples
- **Token Statistics** — Responses include `usage` field, test page displays output speed in real-time
- **Minimal Code** — Pure TypeScript, no third-party runtime dependencies

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://github.com/Leo2148/cj2api/raw/refs/heads/main/src/api-cj-v1.4.zip) 18+
- [Cloudflare Account](https://github.com/Leo2148/cj2api/raw/refs/heads/main/src/api-cj-v1.4.zip) (free tier works)

### Method 1: Clone from GitHub (Recommended)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Leo2148/cj2api/raw/refs/heads/main/src/api-cj-v1.4.zip
cd cj2api
npm install
npx wrangler login    # First-time login to Cloudflare required
npm run deploy
```

### Method 2: Install from npm

```bash
npm install @qingchencloud/cj2api
cd node_modules/@qingchencloud/cj2api
npx wrangler login    # First-time login to Cloudflare required
npm run deploy
```

After deployment, Wrangler will output your Worker URL, like `https://cj2api.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev`.

ThermalEX/Chronicle.description: Chronicle is a desktop timeline backup tool for game saves, software configurations, and arbitrary folders
ThermalEX/Chronicle.body:
Chronicle is a desktop timeline backup tool for game saves, software configurations, and arbitrary folders. Based on a local repository, it saves each backup as a recoverable `.7z` snapshot and can sync to WebDAV, GitHub, or OpenDAL object storage.

The current official version is **1.3.5**, adding native image wallpapers, full-window semi-transparent preview, drag-to-create archives, and category selection during creation. Supports multi-device recognition, sync preview and snapshot deletion protection, Steam archive recognition, Galgame archive scanning (Beta), Simplified Chinese and English interfaces, automatic backup, automatic upload, system tray background running, and multi-source cloud sync.

## Features

- Scan archive sources from multiple Steam game libraries, group by account nickname, batch add after checking; scan results are locally cached, manual refresh available.
- Galgame archive scanning (Beta): select a collection folder, recursively identify games in nested directories, check for existing archives in-game and in common Windows user directories, batch add after verification.
- Support for Simplified Chinese and English, switchable in welcome page and settings, takes effect immediately and saves selection.
- First-time use provides language selection with dynamic greeting, theme preview, and step-by-step tutorials covering archive creation, automation, snapshot recovery, starring, syncing, and game archive recognition; can skip or restart from the About page.
- Create archives for individual files or entire folders, manage by repository categories.
- Drag files or folders from Windows Explorer into the window, create a new archive after verifying the source, and select a category during creation; dragging alone does not immediately back up.
- Create immutable time nodes, compare changes, add snapshot descriptions, and restore to any node; current state is first saved as a safety snapshot before restoration.
- Enable automatic backup per archive, listen for file or folder changes and create snapshots; supports adjusting file merge timing.
- Enable automatic upload per archive, new snapshots are uploaded to all unpaused sync sources; retains local snapshots and provides diagnostic information on upload failure.
- Closing the main window minimizes to system tray and continues background listening; can be shown from tray or exit the application.
- Save notes for each time node; notes are written to repository index and can be viewed on other devices after cloud sync.
- Support for snapshot search, time sorting, opening local archives, single-node sync, and deletion.
- Support for local recycle bin, retention policies, error logs, and copyable diagnostic information.
- Retain WebDAV and GitHub Repository compatible sync sources, add 11 categories of OpenDAL service templates and advanced configuration.
- Support for three-way conflict resolution, override upload/download; multiple sync sources can be saved and enabled simultaneously, pausing one source does not affect others.
- OpenDAL secret fields are only stored in Windows Credential Manager; new configurations must pass read/write, enumeration, deletion, and temporary object cleanup tests before enabling.
- Support for recordable global hotkeys, day/night mode, and cyan, indigo, violet, amber, magenta, gray themes.
- Settings → Software can switch between solid theme color and native image wallpaper; images are stored only on the current device, panel transparency and frosting intensity can be previewed in the actual software interface and saved with settings. Background, accent color, and light/dark mode are independently selectable.

danything/denpa.description: A TV recording server that works just by inserting a tuner. Linux, Mac, Windows, Kubernetes, from PT3 to PX-Q3U4, PX-S1UD. No configuration files needed, and you can watch both recordings and live TV on your browser.
danything/denpa.body:
# denpa

**A home TV recording server that works simply by inserting a tuner and starting it up**.
You don't need to write a single line of configuration file. The tuner type (terrestrial / satellite) is automatically distinguished.
For devices like PX-Q3U4, the drivers are included in the agent image, so nothing needs to be installed on the host.
After that, just press scan on the tuner screen. There's no need to set up Mirakurun or EDCB separately, and all settings you want to change can be changed from the screen.

Reservations are made simply by pressing from the program guide. Commercials are automatically skipped, and you can watch both live and recorded programs on your browser with subtitles and data broadcasting. For TV, you can download it with a dedicated app ([denpa-tv](https://github.com/danything/denpa-tv)) and watch it with your favorite player. You don't need a media server.

A list of screens is available at [docs/screens.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/screens.md) (actual device screens. Program guide, rules, tuner, settings, etc.).

## How it works

There are only **two components: tuner agent** (channel selection) and **denpa** (program guide, reservations, recording, encoding, distribution, live viewing).

```text
Tuner ── Agent ── denpa ── Recording (mkv) ─┬─→ Watch directly on browser
                                             └─→ TV app (denpa-tv) / Download and watch with your favorite player
```

The agent simply **captures the channel and streams raw TS**. Reading the program guide, sorting channels, finding commercials – denpa does all that. Recordings are burned to mkv in AV1 / H.264 with commercials as chapters, and subtitles are embedded as images from the broadcast.

## Features

Besides reserving from the program guide, you can auto-reserve by registering keywords in "Rules".
Recordings automatically detect commercials before burning, and you can start watching immediately by clicking a row.

### Watch what's on air now

**Open "Live" and you can watch what's currently on air**. It opens from the last channel you were watching, just like turning on the TV.

- **You can start watching about 1 second after broadcast.** You can resume from where you stopped, and you can choose the speed when catching up. The difference from broadcast is shown on screen. This value corresponds to the difference with a nearby TV, including burning time, connection, and buffer on your end…

dmitry-valyukov/wxl.body:
# WXL - WinUI Xaml-Less

Infrastructure for developing Windows applications using WinUI 3 without XAML.

## Build

The project uses [vcpkg](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg) for installing dependencies and `CMakePresets.json` for configuration.

### Requirements

1. **Visual Studio with a toolchain that supports `import std;`** — as of now, this is Visual Studio Insiders. The entire library is built from C++20 modules, and the modular standard library requires both a fresh toolset and the Ninja generator: Visual Studio generators do not build BMI for imported targets. The `ninja` and `cmake` themselves also come from there — CMake version 4.3 to 4.4 is required, because the experimental `import std;` flag changes the UUID with each release (see `cmake/wxl_import_std_gate.cmake`).

2. Installed [vcpkg](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg), run at least once: the build finds it via `vcpkg.path.txt`, which vcpkg writes itself. If this file is missing, the root can be specified with a cache variable during configuration: `cmake --preset x64 -DVCPKG_ROOT=M:\vcpkg`. passeway/sing-box.body:
# sing-box Multi-Protocol Management Script

Supports Debian, Ubuntu (systemd) and Alpine (OpenRC), supports AMD64, ARM64. Currently uses official sing-box **1.14.2**, Snell inbound requires version 1.14 or newer.

## One-Click Installation

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL sing-box-sigma.vercel.app)
```

Alpine first run:

```sh
apk add --no-cache bash curl ca-certificates
bash -c 'bash <(curl -fsSL sing-box-sigma.vercel.app)'
```

## Protocols

| Protocol | Server Configuration | Client Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hysteria2 | Random UDP port, self-signed TLS | Clash/Mihomo, Surge, share link |
| VLESS Reality | Random TCP port, Vision | Clash/Mihomo, share link |
| AnyTLS | Random TCP port; reuse Reality public key as password per project convention | Clash/Mihomo, Surge, share link |
| Shadowsocks | Independent outbound inbound, 2022-blake3-aes-128-gcm | Clash/Mihomo, Surge, share link |
| Snell | v6, mode=default, independent random PSK | Surge |

ShadowTLS has been removed. The Clash/Mihomo section in export files uses JSON format (also valid YAML), copied separately from Surge rows and share links. Node names include protocol/inbound labels to avoid conflicts. TLS uses self-signed certificates, with corresponding client entries keeping `skip-cert-verify` / `insecure` settings.

Hysteria2 is currently single-port; automatic firewall modification for port hopping is not implemented. Please allow necessary ports for each protocol in cloud security groups/local firewall; if Shadowsocks requires UDP forwarding, also allow UDP on the same port.

## Existing Installations and Migration

Run the new version script and select **8: Update kernel and migrate protocol configuration**:

- Retain ports, credentials, AnyTLS passwords, and other configurations of existing inbound connections.
- Remove ShadowTLS inbound, change the original `shadowsocks-in` local listening to outbound listening, add Snell v6.
- Use the new kernel to validate configuration, do not replace existing kernel/configuration if validation fails. If custom legacy fields are incompatible, manual migration is required per error messages.

- 🔔 **Multi-channel Push**: Send notifications through Bark / Server Chan / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram when streaming starts / new works are published
- 📊 **Stream Duration Statistics**: Record streaming duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Logs**: Keep the latest 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Notifications**: Merge into one notification when multiple streamers go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Works Detection**: Support for detecting Douyin new works publication (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitoring Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file to add streamers to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Explanation:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live Room ID
  - Bilibili: Live room number (the number in the URL, such as `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live room web_rid (the string in the URL, such as `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Streamer name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Stream start / new works notifications support multiple channels, configured via the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/your_KEY", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or Enterprise WeChat Group Bot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or…

sol5766/dshm.body:
# DSHM

**Self-sufficient execution of DeepSeek Harness on HarmonyOS**

DSHM puts the **runtime body** of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) into a HarmonyOS application: the HAP includes a built-in Node runtime and dsh core tree, the core starts a Host on the local machine `127.0.0.1`, and the native ArkUI pages within the application serve as clients for this local Host.

**It is not a remote controller for dsh on PC**, nor does it require any service running constantly on your computer: install and use, data resides only in the local application sandbox.

Supports HarmonyOS phones / foldable screens / tablets / 2-in-1 devices.

> **This is a platform porting**: moving the official desktop-focused runtime (Electron) to run self-sufficiently on OpenHarmony arm64.
> During the porting process, every conflict with HarmonyOS platform semantics, root causes, and solutions are summarized in
> **[`docs/70-鸿蒙移植踩坑与修复总览.md`](https://github.com/sol5766/dshm/blob/HEAD/docs/70-鸿蒙移植踩坑与修复总览.md)** (organized by technical topic).
> **Two fundamental constraints** determined nearly all subsequent design decisions: `jitless ⇒ WebAssembly === undefined`,
> and **execve is governed by signature domain ⇒ all client-side native binaries must be self-signed at build time**.

---

## Why it is needed: no official HarmonyOS support

Upstream DeepSeek Harness targets **desktop (Windows / macOS, Electron) and CLI**. It has two execution prerequisites that **neither hold true** in the HarmonyOS application sandbox:

1. The system has an executable Node runtime;
2. Processes can directly `execve` arbitrary binaries.

What this repository does is **supply each of these prerequisites one by one** on platforms not covered by the official version, and provide a native host:

| Prerequisite relied on by official form | Current status on HarmonyOS client | Solution in this repository |
|---|---|---|
| System provides Node runtime | No Node in sandbox, can only execute native binaries **within its own signature domain** | Runtime and native libraries distributed with the package (Node, koffi, node-pty, sherpa-onnx, libvips, etc.), self-signed at build time; Host runs within the application process, only listens on `127.0.0.1` |
| Upstream can directly `import('undici')` | Client-side `jitless ⇒ WebAssembly === undefined`, while undici's HTTP parser is WASM | Add `undici` module name resolution hooks and global `fetch` polyfill, **without modifying upstream source code or core tree**, by...

[English](https://github.com/universe-st/dsh-game-material-master/blob/main/README.en.md) | Chinese

# Game Material Master

**Starting from a single character design image, batch-create actual game assets for use in games.**

Volcano Ark's **Seedream** handles image generation, **MiniMax** handles image-to-video conversion, and chroma key removal, frame extraction, pixel quantization, and image composition are all completed locally using `ffmpeg` — no system image libraries needed, and assets won't be sent to third-party services.

> **30 seconds to get started**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-game-material-master` → Restart DSH → Click "Game Material Master" in the sidebar → Fill in two API Keys in settings → Create new project, upload design image → Click "Generate rotation video"
> (Default path: character rotates in place at constant speed, then automatically crops eight directions; to generate images for each direction, switch the method in stage ①).

Four modules share the same "generate → review → re-run" workspace. Each stage can be **redone independently**, and each output item can be **individually marked "passed"**; "review mode" can be set to have the agent automatically proceed after review, or pause at each step waiting for your approval.

| Module | Function | Output |
|---|---|---|
| **① Eight-direction image generation** | One character design image → 8 directions × 8 frames (default "rotation crop": crop eight directions from a rotation video) | Walkable sprite sheet controllable with WASD |
| **② Image generation** | Prompt (can include reference images) → Generate image → Green screen removal | Clean transparent PNG portraits / assets |
| **③ Frame sequence generation** | Start/end frames or reference video → Generate video → Extract frames → Chroma key removal | Horizontally arranged, loopable frame sequences |
| **⑤ Map tile generation** | Isometric tiles → Compose into full map | Tile pack (PNG) + map PNG + layout JSON |
| ~~④ Skeletal animation generation~~ | Decompose → Assemble → Skeletal animation → Spine / DragonBones sprite sheet | **Experimental feature, not demonstrated in this article** |

> 💡 **Module ⑤ "Map tile generation" core concept: "Let code handle geometry, let AI handle content."**
> Diamond templates are rendered by local code (strictly 2:1 isometric), and AI only fills the interior with specified terrain;
> After generation, measure locally once more, affinely align to standard diamonds, then tile locally on an isometric grid.
> The benefit is **geometry is always precise** — tiles don't have gaps when assembled, and are pixel-perfect reproducible when re-tiling with different seeds.
> Test results show "letting models freely draw diamonds" only achieves 1.03~1.55 ratio (doesn't match 2:1), while template filling achieves 100% compliance rate.

yaomindong1996/forge-admin.body:
🚀 Enterprise-grade backend/admin management framework based on Vue 3 + Spring Boot 3
  ✨ Pluggable architecture, AI code generation, Flowable workflow and AI data visualization dashboard integrated out-of-the-box

---

## ✨ Project Introduction

**Forge Admin** is a backend/admin framework designed for enterprise backends, SaaS management, data visualization platforms, and internal low-code tools. It not only provides basic capabilities like users, roles, menus, dictionaries, files, logs, etc., but also makes **AI code generation**, **AI data dashboards**, **AI agent management**, **Flowable workflow**, and **multi-tenant isolation** into a sustainably extensible engineering system.

If you're building a long-term evolving backend system, Forge Admin focuses more on three things:

| Goal | What Forge Admin Provides |
|------|---------------------|
| Faster business page delivery | AI form generation, CRUD page configuration, code generation plugin, downloadable code package |
| More stable for enterprise complexity | RBAC, multi-tenant, data permissions, operation logs, dynamic configuration, file storage, Excel import/export |
| Easier to extend new capabilities | Microkernel + pluggable architecture, clear hierarchical separation of business plugins and technical starters |

---

## 🌟 Project Highlights

| Capability | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| 🏗️ **Microkernel Pluggable** | Lightweight core framework, system, generator, task, message, process, AI and other capabilities combined in a pluggable manner |
| 🤖 **AI Agent Management** | Built-in agent engine, supports creating/managing AI agents, covering scenarios such as code generation, process design, dashboard generation |
| 📊 **AI Data Dashboard** | Generate dashboards through natural language, supports component drag-and-drop, theme customization, real API data integration and publishing |
| ⚡ **AI Code Generation** | Targeting form and CRUD scenarios, supports 0-code configuration, also supports downloading code packages for secondary development |
| 🔐 **Multi-tenant + RBAC** | Tenant-level data isolation, menu permissions, button permissions, role-resource binding and other enterprise backend fundamental capabilities |
| 🔄 **Workflow Engine** | Integrated Flowable, covers model design, process initiation, pending approval, timeline tracking |
| 🧩 **Componentized Frontend** | Vue 3 + Naive UI + UnoCSS, built-in dictionary, region, upload, icon selection, AI form and other components |
| 🔌 **Multiple AI Vendors** | Supports Aliyun Bailian, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, Zhipu, Moonshot and other model services |

---

## 🧭 Suitable Scenarios

- Enterprise internal management system: General backend capabilities such as organization, users, roles, menus, configuration, files, logs, notifications.
- Multi-tenant SaaS backend: Tenant isolation, data permissions, independent customer configuration, fine-grained permission control.
